assetInventory.source: GitHub Release API asset size/digest metadata: https://api.github.com/repos/the-database/mpv-AnimeJaNai/releases/tags/3.7.0
assetInventory.clarification: Windows assets only. The release also publishes -linux-x64 variants of the TensorRT packs; they are not this build's platform and are not part of the catalogue in src/player/native/components/NativeComponentCatalog.cpp.

extractedInventory.pinMatch: The per-file size and SHA-256 pins match the archive extraction.

userInitiatedStore.checks: Verifies archive size and SHA-256, then each model graph size and SHA-256 before publish.
userInitiatedStore.scope: Per-machine RIFE inventory/store only; this inventory does not enable RIFE inference.

rifeComponentArchive.rights: Archive/model redistribution clearance is not established; preserve the unresolved ESC-3 legal position.

packFileMapping.source: the 3.7.0 release packs.json; archive paths are animejanai/inference/<basename>
packFileMapping.note: trtexec.exe is present in the upstream runtime archive but deliberately excluded from this catalogue: nothing in this build invokes it, and native/manifest/components.json resolves ESC-5 by architecture over the bundle inventory.
packFileMapping.runtimeInstalledBytesNote: Not measured on this machine. Historical 3.6.3 builder-resource installed_bytes were corroborated against the project SDK; the 3.7.0 packs.json repeats those sizes, but its archives were not extracted.

corroboration.method: Historical 3.6.3 measurements on this machine, no download needed. The 3.7.0 packs.json reports the same installed_bytes values; the 3.7.0 archives were not downloaded or extracted, so no extracted-file identity is claimed.
corroboration.builderResourceSizes: Historical 3.6.3 packs.json installed_bytes were measured against every matching nvinfer_builder_resource_*_11.dll in the project SDK bin directory: sm75 118526064; sm80 190690928; sm86 180006512; sm89 189048432; sm90 461991536; sm100 290767472; sm120 269391472; ptx 242572912. The 3.7.0 packs.json reports the same installed_bytes mapping; 3.7.0 archives were not extracted, so this does not establish their extracted-file bytes.

sm120ByteIdentity.statement: Historical observation before the 3.7.0 catalogue update: the installed bundle's trt/nvinfer_builder_resource_sm120_11.dll was byte-identical to the project SDK's copy. This does not establish identity with the 3.7.0 archive, which was not extracted.

corroboration.declaredRuntime: The 3.7.0 manifest declares inference_runtime trt-11.3.0.99, the same TensorRT release this project's SDK carries.

negativeControl: F:/ZKS/mikai-native-sdks/animejanai-official/*.7z is the VideoJaNai 2.1.0 cohort (TensorRT 11.0.0.114 / CUDA 13.2.75), measured-incompatible with this project's SDK: serialized engines fail to deserialize across the pair (serialization version 243 vs 244) and cross-paired builder resources fail validateCaskKLibSize. Usable only as a negative control, never as a source for this build's components. Full evidence: native/manifest/videojanai-release.json and native/videojanai-acquisition.md.
digestPolicy: The catalogue pins this tag and every digest in code, so a re-uploaded asset is refused by digest rather than installed. Bumping the release means editing src/player/native/components/NativeComponentCatalog.cpp and this file together; nothing reads either of them from the network at run time.
